description: Manufacturer's properties that describe the rudimentary data of the outlet connection.

MaximumAllowableOutletPressure.description: Highest value of outlet pressure at which the pump or component is capable of functioning on the basis of the materials used.
MaximumAllowableOutletPressure.title: MaximumAllowableOutletPressure

MinimumAllowableOutetPressure.description: Lowest value of outlet pressure at which the pump or component is capable of functioning on the basis of the materials used.
MinimumAllowableOutetPressure.title: MinimumAllowableOutetPressure

NominalPressure.description: Alphanumeric parameter for reference purposes, referring to a combination of mechanical and dimensional properties of a component of a piping system. It comprises the letters PN followed by a dimensionless number.
NominalPressure.title: NominalPressure

OutletAreaOfThePump.description: Free cross-sectional area of the orifice in the outlet connection of the pump.
OutletAreaOfThePump.title: OutletAreaOfThePump

ReliefValveAccumulationPressure.description: Outlet pressure at which the relief valve will pass the total pump flow.
ReliefValveAccumulationPressure.title: ReliefValveAccumulationPressure

ReliefValveBackPressure.description: Pressure at the outlet of the relief valve when the valve is closed.
ReliefValveBackPressure.title: ReliefValveBackPressure

ReliefValveReseatPressure.description: Outlet pressure at which the relief valve will close after passing the total pump flow.
ReliefValveReseatPressure.title: ReliefValveReseatPressure

ReliefValveSetPressure.description: Outlet pressure at which the relief valve begins to open.
ReliefValveSetPressure.title: ReliefValveSetPressure
